acs.text_first_line: AC1 The confirmed court-filing facts reach the legal action
AC2 The judgment facts reach the legal action and the hearing date its hearing
AC3 A field in review is withheld and the previous value is kept
AC4 The type and field set, the threshold and the pass mark are read at their version
AC5 A repeated apply applies once
AC6 A refusal of the reader changes nothing here
AC7 A code that names no litigation column is not mapped and no party name is stored
AC8 The applied facts show on SCR-19 through the composite route

ops_provided: POST /api/recovery/litigation/v1/cases/{caseId}/legal-actions (API-S4-002), applying the confirmed checked fields of a named type in the same transaction
PATCH /api/recovery/litigation/v1/legal-actions/{legalActionId} (API-S4-004), applying the confirmed checked fields of a named type, idempotent on the apply key
GET /api/recovery/litigation/v1/legal-actions/{legalActionId} (API-S4-003), answering the applied facts with the source document and its version
POST /api/recovery/litigation/v1/legal-actions/{legalActionId}/hearings (API-S4-005), used when an extracted hearing_date reaches an action without an open hearing
ops_consumed: GET /api/recovery/document/v1/cases/{caseId}/checked-fields of RWB-P5-E2025-CON (the target shape of legacy DocumentFieldReader.checkedFields(caseId, documentType)), one hop, 2 s, a breaker, GET retry once with jitter
the parameters read of RWB-P3-E1042-CON for EXTRACT_FIELD_THRESHOLD and EXTRACT_ACCURACY_PASS, operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2835; ASM-4689)
the reference-data read of RWB-P3-E1043-CON for LOV-DOC-TYPE and LOV-HEARING, operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2835; ASM-4689)
the case read of rwb-case for the case, its team and its queue behind the scope filter, faked and in no C row of the plan (ASM-4692)
